_readme: Bambu Studio settings for the c3-pal bar in gray Bambu PETG Basic on the A1's textured PEI plate, with the outside as smooth as possible. make_3mf.py starts from a1_project_settings.config (the user's A1 project settings, copied from the owala boots project), applies the system process preset PROCESS_PRESET, makes filament 1 the system preset FILAMENT_PRESET (both read from the Bambu Studio install), then 'print' and 'filament' below on top. Keys starting with '_' are notes. Values are written as Bambu Studio stores them (strings; lists for per-extruder keys).
_PROCESS_PRESET: Thin layers make the side walls smooth; the High Quality presets also slow the outer wall and its acceleration, which is what keeps it free of ringing
_BED_TYPE: The front (screen side) prints face down and takes the plate's even matte grain. PETG releases from textured PEI on its own once cool; no glue

print._note: Process settings on top of PROCESS_PRESET, for the look of the outside.
print._seam_position: Seams line up in one place, which on this rounded box is a corner
print._seam_slope_type: Scarf seam on the outer wall: the start and end of each loop overlap on a slope, so there is no seam bump
print._seam_slope_conditional: Scarf every outer loop, not only where the slicer can't hide the seam in a corner
print._precise_outer_wall: Keeps the outer wall at its true position, so the sides are flat and the parts fit
print._wall_sequence: Inner walls first, so the outer wall is laid against them: smoothest outside
print._wall_loops: 3 walls fill the 1.6 side walls, so no infill pattern shows through the gray
print._elefant_foot_compensation: PETG squashes out on the first layer; this keeps the front's edges crisp
print._reduce_crossing_wall: Travel round inside the walls instead of across them: PETG strings and leaves blobs on the outside
print._initial_layer_speed: Slow first layer (the preset's 50 / 105 is fast for PETG): more time to bond to the plate (2026-11-15: first print didn't stick)
print._brim_type: No brim to trim off the edges; the parts are flat and stick well

filament._note: Filament 1, on top of the PETG Basic preset (its fan and retraction are kept; the first-layer temperatures are raised below).
filament._textured_plate_temp: Preset 70 / 70. Hotter plate for the first layer, a little hotter after, so PETG grips textured PEI (2026-11-15: first print didn't stick)
filament._nozzle_temperature_initial_layer: Preset 245; a bit hotter so the first layer flows into the plate's texture
filament._filament_z_hop: Lift on travel so the nozzle doesn't drag PETG across the top
